edges.reason: The constructor body executes the delegatecall to contractLogic during contract creation
The constructor body performs the raw sstore of the implementation slot
The contractLogic constructor argument is used directly as the delegatecall target, letting the deployer run arbitrary code in the proxy storage context
constructData is forwarded verbatim as the calldata of the constructor delegatecall
The contractLogic argument is written into the PROXIABLE slot without validation, controlling all future delegatecalls
The delegatecall returns the boolean success value stored in the success local variable
The delegatecall returns returndata captured in the __ bytes memory variable
The sstore writes the implementation address into the PROXIABLE state slot
The fallback sloads the implementation address from the PROXIABLE slot into a local variable
The sloaded implementation address becomes the delegatecall target in the fallback
Execution of the fallback body reaches the delegatecall instruction
The fallback delegatecall returns the success flag consumed by the assembly switch
Any external caller (msg.sender) can invoke the payable fallback, which forwards execution to arbitrary implementation code without any reentrancy protection
msg.sender fully controls the calldata that is delegatecalled into the implementation, enabling reentrant calls back into the proxy before state settles
The delegatecalled implementation code can re-enter the proxy fallback, repeating the delegatecall with no guard
The implementation slot written at construction time is later read and used as the delegatecall target in the fallback

normalization_plan.reason: Constructor parameter constructData has no independent semantics beyond being the calldata of the constructor's delegatecall, so it collapses into the constructor function

The success local only holds the result of the constructor delegatecall and adds no independent semantic node
The __ return bytes local is produced solely by the constructor delegatecall and merges into it
The sloaded logic address local exists only as the target operand of the fallback delegatecall, so it merges into that unsafe operation
The fallback success local is only the delegatecall result consumed by the switch and merges into the delegatecall unsafe operation
